<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/knowledge-memory`, `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **24** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**21** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_ERROR (literal, 38 pages)`, `organization_id (literal, 42 pages)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8270c18f243775c9f1e11a8f21bd6641ac72d57c` — the merge of head `f5c87f799f149ee271233ee9ed72e7ce05224850` into base `13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8270c18f243775c9f1e11a8f21bd6641ac72d57c && git checkout 8270c18f243775c9f1e11a8f21bd6641ac72d57c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8 f5c87f799f149ee271233ee9ed72e7ce05224850 && git checkout -B drift-repro 13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8 && git merge --no-ff f5c87f799f149ee271233ee9ed72e7ce05224850

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

REWORK — two blocking items in `knowledge-service.ts` and two test gaps; the spec face itself is as ADR-0161 decided it. Fix list at the end.

Head-sha: `7d6c76da8af461bc776fe921cc345fd0f9e50be2`

Reviewed at the PR's current head. The dispatch named `9652c238ae84a1e149e85c371dff3f646129b199`; the head moved twice during the review (`4267fda877cff7abecba4524cc948d2e0c047e4e`: changeset kind and level, `knowledge-rag.mdx`; then `7d6c76da`: two test doubles). `knowledge-service.ts`, `packages/spec/**` and `knowledge-memory` are byte-identical across the three heads.

**形态**
- Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37103`; no closing keyword beside any other card. `Fixes` is right: all six What items are built.
- Not governed surface: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37335` reads 0 of 12 paths on the register, 901 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold. Ordinary queue landing once accepted.
- Declarations: PR body and changeset both read `Clause-②: yes (widening)` · `Metadata-protocol: added`; `@objectstack/spec` minor, `service-knowledge` and `knowledge-memory` patch. The claim comment 7170014803 was revised from `none` to `added` at 18:08Z. `added` is forced by the gate, not a judgement call: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json` gains two `ai/KnowledgeHit:*` rows and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `none` beside a moved baseline.
- `Skills-docs: none` holds. Read `skills/**`: the knowledge text (`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, its eval `skills-tools-knowledge.json`) teaches source authoring and the `search_knowledge` tool, whose arguments and hit projection this PR leaves alone (row 12). No page teaches `KnowledgeSearchOptions` or the `KnowledgeHit` shape.
- One changeset names all three published packages touched. No `content/docs/releases/` path. No file outside the claim's surface (`knowledge-memory` is the adapter K8 rule 1 names; the claim line was not widened to say so, recorded as a deviation).

**前提实测**
- Blockers #37001, #36993, #37096, #37098, #36994 closed. K8 items 3 and 14 are accepted members with #37103 as first reader; item 13 stays out and the diff adds no grouping member to `IKnowledgeAdapter`, `AdapterContext` or `AdapterSearchOptions`.

**门禁 check-runs** (at `7d6c76da`, read 18:24Z)
- 13 success, 9 skipped, 25 in progress, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check: not measured (still running). At `4267fda8` both had concluded `failure`, with `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` and `Test UI`; the two later commits answer the lint reds, and whether they clear is not measured.
- Local, at `7d6c76da`: `service-knowledge` vitest 292/292 (11 files), `knowledge-memory` 37/37.

**断言与消融** (17 single-line ablations on `knowledge-service.ts` and `knowledge-memory/src/index.ts`, run at `4267fda8`, tree restored)
- 16 turn the suite red: hash compare off (2 + 1 contract), `where` dropped from the freshness read, single-flight off, the `groupBy` + `chunk` refusal off, ungroupable source searched, live title off, widening off, read failure failing open, freshness run in chunk mode (5 red, among them the pre-existing permission and refill cases: the default path is pinned by the old suite as well as the new case), grouping off, repair entry never cleared, projection dropped, refill off, no-value record answered ungrouped, `knowledge-memory` without `docHash` (2), without `headingPath` (1).
- 1 stays green: `SEARCH_FRESHNESS_ROUNDS` 3 → 50. The round cap has no case. Fix 3.
- Chunk default: the service path is unchanged by read (same asks, same `fields: ['id']` re-read, same refill predicate, same hit objects) and by the ablation above. The answer is not byte-identical for a `knowledge-memory` deployment in one respect the PR body does not say: every hit now also carries `docHash` and, when its passage has one, `headingPath`, in chunk mode too. That is K8 items 3 and 14 as decided; the body's "byte-for-byte" should say it.
- Refusals: `groupBy` + `granularity: 'chunk'`, an empty `groupBy` and an unknown `granularity` throw a bare `Error`; the case asserts the message by regex. No `code`, no `status` (ADR-0112; the same package's tool layer refuses with `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400). Fix 2.
- Bounds, by read and probe: per source at most `topK × 5` then one refill at `topK × 20`; freshness at most 3 reads per source per search, each of at most `topK` ids; at most `3 × topK` repairs started per search, each single-flight per document through `serializeRecordSync`, in system context, never awaited, never as the caller. `freshnessRepairs` keeps one string per document found stale and never seen matching again (the body states it).

**逐句核的散文面**
- Changeset: each of the five bullets read against the code and true, with the two exceptions below. `protocol/knowledge.mdx` "Records, not passages" (three paragraphs) and the `KnowledgeHit` and `KnowledgeSearchOptions` sentences: true, same exceptions. `ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`: the example and the closing paragraph are true. `references/ai/knowledge-document.mdx`: generated, two rows, matches the schema.
- Exception a: "the hit's `title` is the record's title as it reads now" holds for a caller the re-check reads for. The system identity gets no re-read, so its title is the indexed one (equal whenever the hash matched; not for an adapter that stores no hash).
- Exception b: "Its document is repaired in the background" is unconditional in the changeset, the docs and the `granularity` jsdoc. See fix 1: the sentence and the code must agree with the source's `refresh` key.

**接受的偏差**
- Repair "once per document until a later search finds its hash matching" is the card's own item 5. Its residue (a second missed change before any search sees the first repair matching is not repaired by this path; a repair that fails is not retried) goes to row 15 with the queue.
- `groupBy` on a `file` / `http` source groups by document: the dev's stated reading of card item 3, accepted.
- A posture that cannot be read makes the check membership-only for that search (logged at `warn`), while a failed freshness read answers nothing. Accepted for now; row 15 or the reconcile card may close it.
- "Container run per AGENTS.md" read as the local package runs, repeated here at the current head.

**范围外去向**
- #37100 (`knowledge-pgvector`, no PR yet): running the suite with `listDocuments` and chunks it owes `docHash` and `headingPath` on hits; it also changes the same `search()` for K7 rule 5. The second to land merges `main`.
- #37308 (row 11, blocked): adds `scope` to the same search path, after this.
- Cloud: nothing in `cloud/` runs `runKnowledgeAdapterContract`, so `knowledge-turso` meets the new cases when #37107 moves it here. At run time it stays correct without the member (membership-only check).
- Row 12: `search_knowledge`'s hit projection is a whitelist and does not carry `docHash`; keep it so when the arguments arrive.

**落地条款**
- Clause-② declared and the path limb hit: no queue before a `VERDICT: PASS` contract record on the landing head. The record below is FAIL.

**Fix list**
1. must-fix — `repairStale` calls `syncRecord` directly and so skips the one predicate (`objectSourcesFor`) that keeps the service's writes out of a source with `refresh.onRecordChange: false`. Probe: such a source, one hit deleted and one changed, record-level search ⇒ one `adapter.delete` and one `adapter.upsert`. The hit is still dropped; the repair is skipped for that source, with a case, and the three texts say so.
2. must-fix (checklist, 拒收断言) — the three argument refusals in `search()` carry `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'` and `status: 400`, and the case asserts both.
3. should-fix — a case for the round cap: more stale leads than three rounds can clear, asserting three reads, the unchecked hits unanswered, and the debug line (the "no more within the refill cap" line also fires there and names the wrong reason).
4. should-fix — `freshnessFields` drops a field the schema does not declare from the projection while the walk and the repair hash the whole row, so a source that names such a field has every record-level hit read as stale, repaired to the same hash, and never answered. Probe: `metadataFields: ['policy', 'created_at']` over a schema without `created_at` ⇒ 0 hits, 1 repair. Read the whole row when any wanted field is undeclared, and give the suite one engine double that honours `fields` on the system read; today both doubles answer it whole, so the sentence "the recomputed hash is the one assembly would compute" is unpinned.
5. nit — the freshness read passes its context inside the query with `as never`; `rereadRow` in the same file uses the trailing options argument the `IDataEngine` contract now declares.
6. nit — PR body: "byte-for-byte" for the default (see above), and the test block is pinned to `9652c238`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7d6c76da8af461bc776fe921cc345fd0f9e50be2`
Local-runs: probe — the package suites, 17 ablations and 5 probe cases were run in a scratch worktree because the dispatch asked whether the claimed tests fail without the change; nothing was pushed.
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts + packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/testing.ts, packages/plugins/knowledge-memory/src/index.ts
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: yes

### ① Derived judgments

- `KnowledgeHit.docHash?` is ADR-0161 K8 item 3 ("The stored hash of the hit's document", first reader #37103) and `KnowledgeHit.headingPath?` is item 14 ("The heading path of the chunk the hit came from, in the chunk's shape", first reader #37103). Both are in the closed table, so K8 rule 5 asks for no dated note. Shapes match rule 3: an optional string; an optional list of strings, outermost first, the shape of `KnowledgeChunk.headingPath`.
- K8 rule 1: each member lands with its reader and a suite case. `docHash` is read by `checkFreshness`; the suite gains two cases under `implements.listDocuments` and one under `implements.chunks`. `headingPath` is carried through and read by the caller; the service does nothing else with it, which is what item 14 and card item 6 decide.
- K8 rule 2 holds at run time: both keys are optional in the schema, and an adapter that returns no hash gets a membership-only check (pinned). The suite ties the hash on hits to `listDocuments` and adds no separate `implements` key; an adapter that lists stored hashes can return them, so the tie is sound.
- Item 13 respected: no grouping member on the adapter contract; grouping is in the service, with K1's reason for not pushing it down.
- `granularity` and `groupBy` are options of `IKnowledgeService`, which K8 names as non-members landing with their reader under ADR-0049. The return type is unchanged (K9 rule 3). No tool argument is added (K9 rule 2 leaves that to row 12).
- Epic rulings: the answer's content still comes from the index copy the caller was admitted to, plus a title read as the caller in the one re-read; the system read of the freshness check only removes hits. The count the permission filter removed stays in a `debug` line.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: two optional options on a published interface and two optional keys on a published schema. Nothing narrows; an existing caller and an existing adapter compile and behave as before.
- `Metadata-protocol: added` with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`: the authorable-surface baseline moved by two rows, which the level axis reads as added keys. The other two packages at `patch` satisfy "at least one package minor".
- Additive for adapters outside this repository: nothing under `cloud/` runs the contract suite today; `knowledge-pgvector` (#37100) meets the new cases when it first runs it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags and `open_questions`: none open. The dev's one out-of-scope note (#37100 owes both keys under the suite) is confirmed.
- SQL push-down: the freshness read materialises at most `topK` ids from hits and reads them with `$in`, and groups in the service. Reason on record: K1, the index may live in another store than the records. No finding.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Overlap: #37100 and #37308 touch the same `search()`; neither has a PR at this head.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts`
- must-fix — the `granularity` text promises that a stale record's "document is repaired in the background", and the implementation does that for every object source, including one whose published `refresh.onRecordChange: false` hands its index to an external indexer. The service's event sync, reap guard and purge all stand down for that key; this path does not. Either the contract sentence gains the exception and the code honours it, or the key no longer means what `knowledge-source.zod.ts` says. Fix 1 above.
- should-fix — "passing it with `granularity: 'chunk'` is refused" names no code. The refusal is a bare `Error`; give it the coded shape the package's tool layer already uses, so row 12 forwards one refusal and not two. Fix 2 above.
- The rest holds against the code and the card's acceptance scenes: `topK` counts groups; one group across sources; a source without the field is not asked; a record with no value is not answered; `file` / `http` by document.

`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts`
- Holds. Both descriptions are true of `knowledge-memory` and of what the service compares. "Absent when the adapter stores no hash" is the membership-only arm.

`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`
- Generated; two rows, in order.

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts`
- must-fix — as above (the repair and `refresh.onRecordChange`).
- should-fix — the projection of the freshness read can differ from what assembly hashed (fix 4), and no double honours `fields` on that read.
- should-fix — the three-round cap is unpinned (fix 3).
- nit — `query.context` with `as never` (fix 5).

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/testing.ts`, `packages/plugins/knowledge-memory/src/index.ts`
- Hold. The adapter returns both keys as stored and copies the path; the suite cases fail without them.

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## 席位核对

ACCEPT — the six items of the round-1 record (PR comment 7170913599) are closed at this head, each pinned by a case that fails without it. Landing waits for the checks still running.

Head-sha: `f5c87f799f149ee271233ee9ed72e7ce05224850`

Delta review: one commit on `7d6c76da8af461bc776fe921cc345fd0f9e50be2`, 8 files, +192 / -70. Read whole against that head; the rest of the PR stands as read in round 1.

**形态**
- Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37103`, the only closing keyword in the body. Body and changeset read `Clause-②: yes (widening)` · `Metadata-protocol: added` · `Skills-docs: none`; `@objectstack/spec` minor, the other two patch. Unchanged since round 1.

**门禁 check-runs** (at `f5c87f79`, read after the push)
- 27 success, 12 skipped, 32 in progress, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates: success. TypeScript Type Check: not measured (its jobs are still running). All-green: not measured.

**逐项核对与消融** (7 single-line ablations at this head, tree restored)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f5c87f799f149ee271233ee9ed72e7ce05224850`
Local-runs: probe — the two package suites and 7 ablations were run in a scratch worktree to confirm each round-1 fix is pinned; nothing was pushed.
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts + packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-tools.ts, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/testing.ts, packages/plugins/knowledge-memory/src/index.ts
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: yes

### ① Derived judgments

- Round 1 stands: `KnowledgeHit.docHash?` and `headingPath?` are ADR-0161 K8 items 3 and 14 in their decided shapes, each landing with its reader and a suite case; item 13 stays out; `granularity` and `groupBy` are service options that K8 names as non-members. The delta adds no member, no key and no option.
- The delta changes two contract sentences in `knowledge-service.ts`: the repair now excepts a source with `refresh.onRecordChange: false`, and the refusal names `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`, `status: 400`. Both are true of the code and pinned.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, spec `minor`, the two packages `patch`. A thrown refusal that gains `code` and `status` is still an `Error` with the same message stem; the options are new in this PR, so no released behaviour narrows.
- `refusal` is exported from a module, not from the package entry: no published export is added.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags and `open_questions`: none open.
- SQL push-down: unchanged from round 1 (at most `topK` ids read with `$in`, K1's reason on record). The whole-row arm of the freshness read is taken only when the source names an undeclared field, and reads at most `topK` rows. No finding.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Overlap: #37100 and #37308 touch the same `search()`; neither has a PR at this head.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts`
- Round-1 must-fix closed: the `granularity` text and the code agree with the published meaning of `refresh.onRecordChange: false`; the service writes nothing to such an index on this path either.
- Round-1 should-fix closed: the refusal is coded and the text says so.

`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`
- Untouched by the delta; hold as in round 1.
